name: Corporates
title: MICE & Corporate Travel for Companies | ETHPL
meta: Offsites, conferences, incentive trips and group travel for companies — itemised proposals, GST invoicing and purchase-order workflows.
heading: For companies and corporate teams
intro: You are usually solving for three things at once: a programme that achieves something, a budget that will survive finance, and a process that procurement will accept. We plan against all three rather than just the first.
concerns: Proposals arrive itemised per delegate, so the number can be defended line by line in a budget meeting. A single bundled figure gets sent back for a breakdown, which costs you a week.
GST-compliant invoicing, purchase-order workflows, vendor documentation and advance schedules — handled as part of the job rather than chased afterwards.
Written safety and movement plans, a named on-ground manager, and an escalation contact. If something goes wrong at 11pm, somebody answers.
The real fear with an offsite is embarrassment in front of leadership. Most of what we do is removing the ways a day can fall apart: transfer timing, AV redundancy, a plan for weather.
formats: Annual sales conferences and town halls
Dealer, channel-partner and top-performer incentive trips
Standalone group flights, visas and hotel blocks
